## Scope

The copyright permission below applies to the thirteen existing artwork files identified by path and hash in `licenses/BRANDING_ASSET_MANIFEST.json`: the desktop SVG and PNG, Android vector drawable, and ten launcher PNGs. Editable SVG/XML forms are included; no claim is made that the original ChatGPT image or conversation is itself bundled. It does not cover fonts, third-party artwork, code, the Relay name as a trademark, or future assets not explicitly included.

Permission is granted only to the extent the Relay project has the relevant rights. No exclusive copyright ownership or independent third-party clearance is asserted. Preserve existing verified notices. The owner-provided historical reference's independent rights and the extent of copyright in AI-generated material remain unverified. The following standard MIT/Expat permission terms concern copyright; trademark/product-identity permissions are separate in BRANDING.md. In the license text, “Software” refers to the covered artwork and accompanying editable forms.
